culprit_citations.quoted_text: Alloy Technologies, Inc. | Growth Capital Loan (Prime + 5.25 % interest rate, 13.75 % floor, 5.00 % EOT payment) | 8/8/2024 | 913 | 949 | 949 | 8/31/2027
Ao1 Holdings Inc. | Growth Capital Loan (Prime + 1.00 % interest rate, 7.75 % floor, 3.00 % EOT payment) | 12/13/2024 | 1,114 | 1,128 | 1,114 | 12/1/2027

findings.detail: The holdings rate field captures non-coupon components or spreads, including Alloy's 5.00% EOT payment instead of its 13.75% coupon floor.

rationale: F27 is a real cross-dataset error, not an unusually high income yield. The raw debt schedule shows that extracted holdings rates used to compute WAC are not all-in current coupons. Alloy is stored at 5.0 even though the source separately states Prime + 5.25%, a 13.75% floor, and a 5.00% EOT payment; Ao1 is stored at 3.0 even though the source separately states Prime + 1.00%, a 7.75% floor, and a 3.00% EOT payment. The exact matches to the EOT payment demonstrate a column-remap/extraction defect that understates holdings WAC and causes the 6.5341 F27 comparison failure.
